# whiteSpace, display=none, overflow and justifyContent on bubbletea.
#
# Each was listed as not answered yet: a `nowrap` label wrapped at its box's
# width, a node displayed none was drawn, a box given a height and
# `overflow=hidden` grew with its text, and a row's justifyContent left its
# children at its start. The snapshot is the screen as text.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
# nowrap: one line, cut at the 10 columns inside the box's border.
grep '(?m)^│one line, │ *$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
# pre: the lines written, neither joined nor broken.
grep '(?m)^│first     │ *$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
# the default wraps between words.
grep '(?m)^│wraps at  │ *$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
# display=none draws nothing, not even the line it would have taken.
! grep 'hidden' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
grep '(?m)^│words     │ *\n└─+┘ *\n┌─+┐ *\n│row one' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
# overflow=hidden: two rows of the three, inside the border it keeps.
grep '(?m)^│row one   │ *$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
! grep 'row three' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
# justifyContent across a 30-column row: start, end, center, spaceBetween.
grep '(?m)^a b {27}$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
grep '(?m)^ {27}c d$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
grep '(?m)^ {13}e f {14}$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi
grep '(?m)^g {28}h$' app.sngl.snapshots/fit.ansi

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component fit ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text(value="one line, kept\nwhole", style={whiteSpace=nowrap, width=96px, borderWidth=1px})
        ui.text(value="first\nsecond", style={whiteSpace=pre, width=96px, borderWidth=1px})
        ui.text(value="wraps at words", style={width=96px, borderWidth=1px})
        ui.text(value="hidden", style={display=none})
        ui.vbox(style={height=64px, overflow=hidden, borderWidth=1px, width=96px}) {
            ui.text(value="row one")
            ui.text(value="row two")
            ui.text(value="row three")
        }
        ui.hbox(style={width=240px, gap=8px}) {
            ui.text(value="a")
            ui.text(value="b")
        }
        ui.hbox(style={width=240px, gap=8px, justifyContent=end}) {
            ui.text(value="c")
            ui.text(value="d")
        }
        ui.hbox(style={width=240px, gap=8px, justifyContent=center}) {
            ui.text(value="e")
            ui.text(value="f")
        }
        ui.hbox(style={width=240px, gap=8px, justifyContent=spaceBetween}) {
            ui.text(value="g")
            ui.text(value="h")
        }
    }
}

func testFit(t test.Test, c fit) {
    t.snapshot("fit")
}

ui.window {
    fit
}
